verdict.rationale: Gusto's app-integrations docs say it works with accounting apps, and its webhooks (e.g. payroll.paid) and payroll reports could support an integration that pushes payroll data out. None of the evidence shows an automatic journal-entry sync, and it never names QuickBooks or Xero. Missing for 10: a documented native QuickBooks/Xero connector, automatic posting of payroll journal entries, account/GL mapping configuration, and hands-on corroboration that the sync works.
